headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving pockets of strong performance.
summary: Coforge posted the fastest top‑line expansion at 53.6% YoY, while Infosys grew only 1.5% YoY. AI‑related revenue rose sharply for several firms, notably HCLTech (+29% AI revenue) and TCS (AI revenue >10% of total). Profit margins improved for HCLTech and TCS, but Infosys profit grew just 6% YoY. Guidance remained modest, with Infosys trimming FY27 growth to 1‑2% and HCLTech targeting 2.5‑4% YoY.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI revenue surged across the sector, with double‑digit growth at Infosys, HCLTech and TCS, and a 47% jump at LTM.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins rose for HCLTech (18.2%) and TCS (24%), reflecting higher‑value AI and digital services.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge and Tech Mahindra delivered double‑digit YoY growth, while Infosys and Wipro lagged with low single‑digit increases.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
Strong AI revenue (>10% of total) and high operating margin of 24%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and profit rose modestly 6%.
Revenue growth slowed to 9.1% YoY and profit fell 1.9%.
